headline: SpaceX leases its Colossus 1 supercomputer to Anthropic
body: A quiet day. Anthropic will use the full capacity of SpaceX/xAI's Colossus 1 supercomputer, more than 220,000 Nvidia GPUs, amid a compute shortage. More compute raises Capability Velocity, and a deal between two big players adds a touch of Power Concentration, so Enslaved God and Zookeeper edged up. Horizon Balance eased to +2.17.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.1, mostly from the Colossus 1 lease (+0.13). Zookeeper +0.09, from the Colossus 1 lease (+0.10). Reversion -0.08, from the Colossus 1 lease (-0.09).
